warpathAcquisition.guidance: A visible Warpath trade does not mean its materials are unlocked. The reviewed 2.0 trade table gates Bright Horn / White Dragon Scale purchases behind Thunderbolts and Lightning (Proud), Abyssal Horn / Black Dragon Scale behind Into the Abyss (Proud), and Crown of Lament / Rancorous Lance behind Lock Horns (Proud). Badges do not bypass those quest gates. Conflux treasure sets are separate sources: unlock the relevant Cycle and set first. The Proud equipment table is a target, not an equip restriction; use a suitable Warpath earlier if you obtain it through an unlocked source.
warpathAcquisition.scope: Read-only structural analysis of a published 2.0 table copy; not a fresh 2.0.6 game extraction or in-game shop test. Official 2.0.3–2.0.6 patch notes do not document changes to these gates. This does not prove that every alternate Conflux or reward route is gated to Proud.
warpathAcquisition.tableSourceLimit: This archive contains a modded table with three added voucher purchases. The builder appends those three rows; they were excluded from the review. No mod was installed or executed. The reported gates belong to the existing material-purchase rows.
